name: Level Crossing Barrier Activation Guard
description: When the train approach detection flag b_approach=1, the level crossing barrier must lower within 30 s. Guarded UPR: the barrier activation command applies only when b_approach=1.

elements.name: Train Approach Detection Flag
elements.description: Binary flag: 0=no train within 1500m, 1=train approaching level crossing.

uncertainty.source: ERA level crossing detection system: track circuit or balise-based approach detection

elements.name: Maximum Barrier Activation Time
elements.description: ERA level crossing technical specification: barrier must lower within 30s of approach detection

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(barrier) = lower_command if b_approach=1, else clear — guard activates barrier sequence when approach detected
consistency_relations.upr_description: Guarded UPR: barrier lowering sequence applies only when train approach flag b_approach=1 is active.
